name: Planning Poker
highLevelGoals: The Moderator aims to efficiently create, configure, and manage Planning Poker games, including adding, editing, and deleting items for estimation, to streamline the sprint goal setting process.

The Moderator seeks to finalize estimates accurately and quickly, whether by accepting an average, automatically filling in unanimous estimates, or manually entering an agreed-upon value, to ensure progress in sprint planning.
The Moderator desires to access and export comprehensive game transcripts and historical data to review past estimations, analyze trends, and maintain records for future reference.
The Moderator aims to securely manage their account details and game data, including creation, modification, and deletion, to maintain privacy and control over their information.
The Moderator wants to configure game settings, such as estimation scales and the number of participants, to tailor the Planning Poker experience to their team's specific needs and preferences.
The Estimator aims to easily join and actively participate in Planning Poker games, understanding the items being estimated and the progress of the estimation round.

The Estimator seeks to make informed estimation decisions by viewing all items for estimation, understanding other participants' estimates, and having the flexibility to change their own estimate during a round.
The Estimator desires tools to facilitate effective discussion and time management during estimation rounds, such as a visible countdown timer, to ensure focused and productive conversations.
The Estimator aims for a personalized and consistent user experience, including the display of personal identifiers and consistent card ordering, to enhance engagement and clarity during the game.
The Researcher aims to access and study game results in a non-identifiable way to analyze estimation patterns, convergence behaviors, and other relevant data without compromising participant privacy.
lowLevelGoals: The Moderator can initiate a new Planning Poker game by interacting with the system to specify initial game parameters.
The Moderator can generate a unique URL that Estimators can use to join the created game session.
The Moderator can retrieve and display the complete list of items currently available for estimation in an active game.
The Moderator can add a new item for estimation to an active game by providing the item details to the system.
The Moderator can modify the details of an existing estimation item within a game by specifying the item ID and new details.
The Moderator can remove an estimation item from a game by providing the item ID to the system.
The Moderator can choose a specific item from the list to initiate a new estimation round for that item.
The Moderator can select an item that has already been estimated and initiate a new estimation round for it.
The Moderator can finalize an item's estimate by accepting the calculated average of all participant estimates.
The Moderator can trigger the system to automatically set the final estimate for an item if all participants have provided the same estimate.
The Moderator can input a specific, agreed-upon estimate for an item.
The Moderator can reveal all submitted estimates to participants immediately after the estimation round concludes.
The Moderator can view a list of past game sessions they have managed.
The Moderator can request a full transcript of a past game, including all estimates and discussions.
The Moderator can export historical game data, such as estimation trends and participant statistics, in HTML format.
The Moderator can export historical game data, such as estimation trends and participant statistics, in CSV format.
The Moderator can register a new account by providing necessary credentials.
The Moderator can access their account by providing their registered credentials.
The Moderator can request a password reset or reminder if they forget their login credentials.
The Moderator can modify their personal account information (e.g., email, password).
The Moderator can initiate the deletion of their account and associated data, requiring proper authentication.
The Moderator can remove specific game sessions and their associated data by providing the game ID.
The Moderator can set or change the estimation scale (e.g., Fibonacci, T-shirt sizes) for a game.
The Moderator can define the maximum number of estimators allowed in a game.
The Moderator can upload a spreadsheet containing stories to populate the estimation items for a game.
The Moderator can copy story details from a spreadsheet and paste them directly into the system to create estimation items.
The Estimator can join an active game session by providing the game's unique identifier.
The Estimator can fetch the details of all items currently awaiting estimation in the game.
The Estimator can receive real-time notifications about the current estimation round's status, such as when all estimates are submitted or the round ends.
The Estimator can see their local timezone displayed within the game interface.
The Estimator can provide their estimate for an item by selecting their chosen value.
The Estimator can retrieve the estimates submitted by other participants for a completed round.
The Estimator can update their estimate for an item before the round concludes by submitting a new value.
The Estimator can access and review estimates submitted in previous rounds for the current item.
The Estimator can navigate through a history of estimates for a specific item.
The Estimator can initiate a visible countdown timer to manage discussion time during an estimation round.
The Estimator can view the remaining time in the current estimation round.
The Estimator can reset the countdown timer for the current estimation round after an estimate has been submitted.
The Estimator can receive specific notifications showing which participants have submitted their estimates during the current round.
The Estimator can configure a display name or identifier that will be shown to other participants.
The Estimator can upload and display a small thumbnail photo next to their name for better identification.
The Estimator can request estimation cards from the system, ensuring they are always presented in a predefined, consistent order.
The Researcher can retrieve game results where all participant-identifiable information has been removed or obfuscated.
